regime_context: China A-shares shows an extremely narrow, one-narrative tape: only Coal and Banks clear the eligibility gate (9% of the universe), rotation is directional=false, absorption is low at 0.33, and the headline Hurst is mean-revert while Banks is trend. Critically, the trend-gate edge did NOT hold on this market's history (gate_helps=false), so even the detector's one validated drawdown-control mechanism is not reliable here — the tape mean-reverts and whipsaws, so any lean must be especially humble. Track record direction accuracy is only 0.337, reinforcing a low-conviction posture.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Banks complete a confirmed handoff from Coal: 512800.SS (Banks) overtaking 515220.SS (Coal) in 10-day relative return against CSI 300 for 5 consecutive sessions would retire the watch toward a durable financials/value leadership, while Coal re-establishing durability above 0.65 would keep the one-narrative intact.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are the only eligible theme with a trend Hurst tag (0.78 durability) and very high breadth (0.944), which is the one leg the detector's own framing says to weight for trend-health. Unlike Coal (mean-revert, durability 0.54), Banks show internal cohesion consistent with a durable trend rather than a reflexivity-prone burst. The lean is supported by the trend-gate eligibility and breadth legs, NOT the rank score, and is tempered by the crowded flag (crowding_z 1.74), which is a size-down caution only.
evidence: second-highest score (1.03) with challenger status to Coal
theses.dissent: Banks are crowded (crowding_z 1.74, the most crowded eligible theme) and on a mean-reverting A-shares tape the trend gate failed to cut drawdown historically — trend-following the most crowded value theme is exactly the setup that whipsaws.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS underperforms CSI 300 by 3% or more within the 20 trading days before the check-by date

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal is the rank leader but carries a mean-revert Hurst tag, durability 0.54, and breadth of only 0.5 — the internal structure does not support a trending read. With absorption low (0.33) and one_narrative=true, the leadership is thin and reflexivity-prone. The avoid lean is grounded in the durability/breadth legs and the mean-revert tag, not the high rank, and does not imply a fade or short.
theses.dissent: Coal has the highest score and is the one_narrative leader; in China, policy-driven energy security flows can sustain a coal theme far longer than breadth/durability metrics suggest, and avoiding the leader has been a documented failure mode.

falsifier.text: 515220.SS sustains relative outperformance of 5% or more over CSI 300 and Coal's durability_bar rises above 0.65 before the check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
